terms: Free to enter. No purchase necessary.
Open to players aged 18 or over, or 21 or over where local law requires.
One entry for each day you play in the week, up to 7. You need to play on at least 4 days to enter.
One winner per pool each week. Pools are split by region and by product.
Winners are picked at random by an independent process and checked for eligibility before any prize is confirmed.
Winners are contacted by email and must reply within 14 days.
Not available in every region. Local rules apply. Promoter details and full terms to be added.
